verdict: Organic activity holds across all three locations; O'Hare visibility needs attention now.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, paid channels carried zero spend and generated zero leads — all measurable activity came from Google Business Profile and organic search. Combined, your three locations logged 395 GBP actions in the last 28 days, with O'Hare Precision accounting for the largest share. The concern this week is O'Hare: GBP engagement fell 71% week-over-week and went dark for four consecutive days through August 2, which — alongside a corresponding drop in search clicks — points to a listing visibility disruption rather than a demand slowdown. A listing audit is already underway to identify and resolve the cause. Forte Metals is a brighter spot, with organic search clicks spiking sharply over the last 7 days, a sign that visibility there is moving in the right direction.

watch_item.issue: O'Hare Precision's Google Business Profile went dark for four straight days, with GBP actions and search clicks both dropping sharply — consistent with a listing visibility disruption.
watch_item.fix: A full listing audit is in progress to identify what changed and restore normal visibility as quickly as possible.
